about: The host's lines. ev says when a line can play; t is what's said and shown as the caption. Record them with tools/make-voice.js. Changing a line's text makes the script record it again.

lines.t: Welcome to fafo! Phones out, scan the code, let's get going!
Evening, everyone! Scan the code on the screen to join!
Right, who's playing? Scan the code and pick a name!
Welcome to fafo, where you find out who your friends really are!
Ooh, a new challenger!
Look who finally showed up!
Another one! Lovely!
Welcome aboard!
They're in! No backing out now!
Fresh competition!
Good name! Questionable choice of friends!
Make yourself at home!
The more the merrier!
Right then! Let's play!
Here we go! Phones at the ready!
Game on! May the best friend win!
Let's find out who's been paying attention!
No pressure! Well, a little bit of pressure!
Let the games begin!
No holds barred tonight! What happens here stays here!
Adults only from here on! Let's get filthy!
Phones out, inhibitions off! Let's go!
Whose photo is this? Think hard!
A photo from one of you! Whose is it?
Someone in this room took this one!
Look closely! Whose is it?
Somebody's camera roll is about to be exposed!
Next photo! Keep a straight face, whoever you are!
Whose song is this? Somebody picked it!
Listen up! Which one of you chose this?
This one says a lot about someone!
Whose taste in music are we judging now?
Somebody's favourite song! Whose?
Whose answer is this?
One of you picked this! Who?
Who said that? Think about it!
How well do you really know each other?
Quips! Get your thumbs ready!
Writing time! Be funny! Or at least try!
Quips! Two of you, one prompt, and the room decides!
The Last Lash! Everyone writes, everyone votes!
Last Lash! Double points! Make it count!
A landslide! Every single vote!
Total wipeout!
Not even close!
The people have chosen!
A clear winner!
That one got the laughs!
Dead even. Nobody wins, nobody loses.
A draw. You're both equally funny. Or not.
And the best answer goes to…
Comedy gold! Take a bow!
Who said it! Answer honestly, then try to look innocent!
Tell us about yourself! We'll work out who's who!
One question, all of you! Then we guess who wrote what!
Two truths and a lie! Lie well!
Tell us two true things and one lie! We'll see how well we know you!
Time to find out who's a good liar!
Mind meld! Think like your partner! No talking!
Same prompt, same answer! Let's see who's on the same wavelength!
Pairs time! Read each other's minds!
Great minds think alike!
Spooky! Are you two sharing a brain?
Not one match. You lot don't think alike at all.
Zero mind melds. Awkward.
Hot seat! One of you answers, the rest of you guess!
Somebody's in the hot seat! How well do you know them?
Hot seat time! Answer honestly!
Everybody knew! You're an open book!
They know you too well!
Nobody knew that. Do you lot even talk?
Full of surprises, this one.
Fakin' it! One of you has a different question. Find the faker!
Check your phone! Answer the question, and don't give anything away!
Somebody's faking it this round! Watch closely!
Caught faking it! Nice work, detectives!
Busted! You can't fake it with this lot!
The faker got away with it! Smooth!
Wrong person! The real faker is laughing at you!
Guess the year! Closest wins!
When did it happen? Get as close as you can!
Time travel round! Name that year!
Higher or lower! Trust your gut!
Higher or lower? Make the call!
One number on the board. Is the next one bigger?
Buzzer round! First right answer wins!
Fingers on buzzers! But get it wrong and it costs you!
Speed round! Fastest right answer takes it all!
Fastest finger in the room!
Too quick for the rest of you!
Bluff! Lie convincingly!
Time to lie! Make it believable!
One true answer, lots of lies! Find the truth!
Closest number! Nobody gets this exactly! Probably!
Numbers round! Make a wild guess!
Guess the number! Closest wins!
Odd one out! Which one doesn't belong?
Spot the odd one out!
One of these is not like the others!
Would you rather! Choose wisely!
Tough choices ahead!
Would you rather! No sitting on the fence!
Never have I ever! Be honest!
Confession time!
Never have I ever! We'll know if you're lying!
Name that tune! Ears open!
Here comes a song! What is it?
Listen carefully! Name that tune!
You know this one! Probably!
Music round! No humming along!
Quiet, everyone! Here it comes!
Famous faces! Who is it?
It starts blurry! Guess early for more points!
Somebody famous! Who is it?
Who's behind the blur?
You've definitely seen this face before!
Flag round! Which country?
Name that flag!
Here's a flag! Where's it from?
Flags! Geography nerds, this is your moment!
Careful! Some of these look very alike!
Name the country from its shape!
Here's an outline! Which country?
Map round! No turning your head sideways!
One shape, four guesses! Which country?
Capital cities! Careful, these get tricky!
What's the capital? It's not always the biggest city!
Capital round! Think before you tap!
Name the capital! Don't fall for the famous one!
Which is bigger? Trust your gut!
Two countries! Which one's larger?
Size matters this round! Which is bigger?
Maps lie! Which country is really bigger?
Trivia time!
Here's one for the know-it-alls!
Brains on! Trivia round!
Trivia! Read the question carefully!
Question time! No phoning a friend!
Emoji puzzle! Decode it!
Read the emoji! What is it?
Emoji round! Think like a teenager!
Little pictures, big brain! What is it?
Imposter round! Check your secret word, and keep it secret!
One of you has a different word! Find them!
Imposter time! Trust no one!
Someone's bluffing this round! Watch their faces!
Who's most likely to? Be honest! Brutally honest!
Time to judge your friends!
Most likely to! Choose wisely, they'll find out!
This one's about you lot! Vote!
Final round! Double points! Everything to play for!
Last one! Double points! Don't blow it!
This is it! Final round, double points!
One more round, worth double! Anyone can still win!
Five seconds!
Clock's ticking!
Hurry up!
Come on, lock it in!
Any time now!
Everyone's in!
All locked in! Let's see!
That was quick!
Confident lot, aren't you?
Every single one of you! Too easy!
Clean sweep! Well done!
Everybody got it! I'll make the next one harder!
Full marks all round! Suspicious!
Not a single one of you. Impressive.
Nobody. Absolutely nobody.
Wow. Zero for everyone.
I'm not angry. Just disappointed.
Well, that went badly.
Only one of you got it! Show-off!
Just one person! Take a bow!
One genius in the room!
A lone hero!
Some of you knew that.
A few of you got it.
Not bad. Not great either.
Some sharp minds in here.
Half the room knew it. The other half is guessing.
Fooled the whole room! Poker face of the year!
Nobody saw that coming!
Masterful deception!
You lot don't know each other at all!
Well, that was obvious.
Everyone knew that was yours.
Couldn't be more you if you tried.
Caught red-handed!
Busted! Nice detective work!
The imposter has been found!
Nowhere to hide!
The imposter got away with it!
Wrong person! The imposter walks free!
Fooled you all!
A natural liar! Watch out for this one!
The people have spoken!
Pretty much unanimous!
No surprises there!
Sorry! Your friends have decided!
A split vote. Interesting.
Nobody can agree on this one.
Opinions are divided.
Let's check the scores!
Here's how it stands!
Scoreboard time!
Look at that scoreboard!
Halfway decent. Some of you.
It's close at the top!
Neck and neck!
Anyone's game!
Somebody's running away with it!
Can anyone catch the leader?
The rest of you need to wake up!
That's the game! Let's see the winner!
Game over! And the winner is…
We have a champion!
And that's that! Bragging rights go to…
It's a tie! Nobody gets bragging rights!
A tie! Unbelievable! Rematch?
Paused. Go grab a drink.
Taking a little break.
Pause. Nobody move.
We've lost someone. Give them a moment.
Somebody dropped out. Hang on.
And we're back!
Right, where were we?
Back to it!
Again? Love it!
Rematch! Let's go!
One more game! It's always one more game!
Yeah! Let's go again! Love it!
Sound check! Can everyone hear me?
Testing, testing! Is this thing on?
Split or steal! One pot of points, two players. Can you trust each other?
Time for Split or steal! Look them in the eye. Do you believe them?
Split or steal! Everyone else, place your bets!
They split it! Friendship wins, for now!
Both split! Look at that, honest people!
Shared! I'm almost disappointed!
Stolen! Oh, that's cold!
They took the lot! Absolute snake behaviour!
Betrayal! Never trust that smile again!
Both of you stole? Nobody gets anything! Beautiful!
Greedy, greedy! Zero points each!
Two thieves, no money! Fuck around and find out!
Draw it! Grab your phone and show us your art skills. Or lack of them!
Time to draw! No words, no letters, just pure talent!
Draw it! Let's see how far this goes off the rails!
Nailed it! All the way down the line!
It made it! Somebody give that chain a medal!
Unbelievable! It survived the whole room!
That went downhill fast!
How did we get from that to that? Incredible!
Lost in translation! Who drew that?
Lowest number wins! Go low, but not too low. Everyone else is thinking the same thing!
Pick a number! Lowest one nobody else picked takes the points!
Mind games time! Outsmart the room!
Nobody saw that coming! Well played!
A big brain move! The points are yours!
Sneaky! The lowest number standing wins!
You all think alike! Nobody wins that one!
Total clash! Not a single number survived!
Great minds think alike, and lose together!
Shot in the dark! Hide in a square, shoot a square, and pray!
Lights out! Pick your hiding spot and take your shot!
Shot in the dark! Last one standing wins!
Got 'em! Down they go!
Direct hit! Welcome to the ghost club!
Ouch! Didn't see that coming, did you?
Everybody missed! Terrible aim, all of you!
Not a single hit! Keep shooting!
Last one standing! What a survivor!
And then there was one! Champion of the dark!
Untouchable! The last one left alive!
Herd mind! Don't be clever. Be normal!
Think like everyone else! Moo if you have to!
Herd mind! Follow the crowd!
The herd has spoken!
Great minds think alike! Points for the herd!
Moo! The herd wins!
No herd this time! You're all too original!
Split down the middle! Nobody scores!
Showdown! Rock, paper, scissors against everyone!
Fists ready! It's a showdown!
Ha! Read you like a book!
Brutal! Big win in the showdown!
Total chaos! Everyone beats somebody!
Stalemate! Again!
Who's older? It's closer than you think!
Birthday quiz! Who was born first?
Who's older? No googling!
Cash or crash! The pot keeps growing. Know when to walk away!
How greedy are you feeling? Cash or crash!
Cash or crash! Don't be the last one in!
Crash! Should have cashed out!
Boom! Greed gets punished!
And it's gone! All of it!
Smart money! Banked!
Chicken! But a rich chicken!
Categories! Think of something nobody else will!
One letter, one category. Be original!
Original thinkers! Points for you!
Nobody else thought of that! Nice!
You all wrote the same thing! Nobody scores!
Zero points! Be more creative!
Quick draw! Eyes on your phone, partner. Don't shoot early!
It's a showdown! Fastest finger in the room wins!
Quick draw! Wait for it... wait for it...
Fastest finger in the west!
Now that's a quick draw!
Blink and you missed it!
You all shot too early! Read the screen!
Nobody waited! Twitchy bunch!
Hot potato! Say something, pass the bomb, and pray!
Here comes the bomb! Don't be holding it when it blows!
Hot potato! Talk fast, pass faster!
Boom! Too slow!
Kaboom! Someone's toast!
And it blows! Should have passed it faster!
Pump it! Blow it up, but don't let it pop!
Balloon time! How brave are your thumbs?
Nice and big! Banked!
Now that's a balloon!
Pop, pop, pop! Greedy, the lot of you!
Tug of war! Red versus Blue! Tap like your life depends on it!
Grab the rope! It's tug of war!
Thumbs ready! Red against Blue!
What a pull!
They dragged them right over the line!
Spot it! Find the odd one out!
Eyes sharp! One of these is not like the others!
Eagle eyes!
Spotted it! Too quick!
Simon says: get your phones out! Only when Simon says!
Simon says... play Simon says!
Gotcha! Simon didn't say!
Out! Listen to Simon!
Simon is impressed!
And we have our survivors!
Count up! One tap each, no talking, and don't tap at the same time!
Time to read each other's minds. Count together. No talking!
You did it! Telepathy!
Perfect teamwork! I'm shocked!
Crash! Back to zero!
So close, and yet so many crashes.
Act it out! No talking, just your body!
Charades time! Shout those guesses!
Lights, camera, act it out!
Give that actor an Oscar!
What a performance!
Not bad! A few got there.
Not a single one! Was that even acting?
